Observer UTC offset per vessel flag

Observer trips linked to a logsheet, grouped by vessel flag. Each pair of charts shows the distribution of UTC offsets derived from the observer's own datetime data:

  • Longline — obsv.l_set.set_dtime − utc_set_dtime (per fishing set)
  • Purseseine — obsv.s_day.start_dtime − utc_start_dtime (per fishing day)
